{{Quote|I'm so sorry, mistress Padmé, but the director of Bagrila Industries is unable to take your comm.|C-3PO, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
'''Bagrila Industries''' was a business that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to assemble a civilian [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to assist in the [[Battle of Lanteeb|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and Bagrila Industries was one of a number of organizations that she attempted to secure support from in her endeavor. However, the [[Director/Legends|director]] of Bagrila Industries did not accept a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] message from Amidala's [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
